input.shape: exactly one fn iterate(k_h2:u64,...,last:bool); unexpected shape raises TransformError

output.dispatch: public iterate tests the uniform ncols1/np arguments and calls the matching specialization; otherwise calls iterate_generic

transform_rules: specialized ncols1/np are substituted as typed literals such as (4 as i32)
only statically bounded while loops with constant start/step/bound are unrolled
loop bodies are alpha-renamed per copy so declarations cannot collide
private array indices (kqc,kqold,kqmn,rsa,scl,sh2,b) are folded to typed constant indices
runtime KV-sequence iteration outside iterate is untouched
comments are lexed as tokens so braces inside comments do not affect structure
invariants: every fmaf/expf/bits/frombits/h2/mulh2/mma call and load/store address is preserved textually
no arithmetic is removed or reassociated
all guards and mapping expressions remain
output is deterministic for a given input
specialized body must contain no while loop and no dynamic private-array index or TransformError is raised
failure_mode: TransformError on unbalanced braces, missing/duplicate iterate, unexpected parameter list, unterminated statement, unbounded while remaining in a specialization, or non-constant private array index
non_claims: does not compile or run CUDA/GPU
does not claim acceptance or speedup
does not edit generated C or add native callbacks
